svg.title: Cleany sorting workflow
svg.desc: YOLO detects an item, a settle gate waits until it is still, DINOv2 plus a head classify it as metal, plastic or other. Other items go to the mixed bin through the door mechanism. Metal and plastic items are grasped by the ACT model and placed by hardcoded arm poses over their bin.
svg.text: A model decides what the item is, fixed math moves the arm, and a learned policy only does the grasp.
cut the box out of each
grasped by the arm, placed over its own bin
one OPEN command to the ESP32
trash drops into the mixed bin
arm back at its start pose
arm back at its start pose
Numbers show the order inside each group.
